basic_info.description: Highly desirable corner unit with generous open living space. Unit 7J offers 1530 square feet with TWO split primary suites, 2.5 baths (2 ensuite), Water, Bridge and Downtown skyline views in a resort-like setting. Parking includes hard to get Electric Vehicle Charger already installed. The Brannan's interior was designed by French Interior Designer Christian Liaigre and inspired by the historic San Francisco Waterfront. The Brannan offers a full service of luxury amenities that include 24-hr security, a door person in each tower, heated 75 ft. lap pool, jacuzzi, gym/fitness center, concierge services, spa & BBQ area and 1 car parking. Located 1 block from the Embarcadero Waterfront, close to Ferry Building Plaza, Farmers Market, Oracle Park (Giants), Chase Center (Warriors), Caltrain, shops, world-class restaurants and close to all forms of transportation.
